nintendoNotes: Current verified Nintendo data for New Super Mario Bros. U Deluxe. Storage, languages, multiplayer and platform-specific features are separated from measured performance values.
tagline: Two complete side-scrolling Mario adventures in one compact Switch package.
fitFor: Players who want a large number of short platforming courses
notFitFor: Players who already exhausted the Wii U originals

gameplayPillars.title: Classic 2D Mario
gameplayPillars.description: Precise running and jumping, power-ups, secret exits and multiplayer interactions form the core.

gameplayPillars.title: Two adventures
gameplayPillars.description: The package includes both New Super Mario Bros. U and the full New Super Luigi U campaign.

gameplayPillars.title: Accessible character options
gameplayPillars.description: Nabbit avoids enemy damage and Toadette can use the Super Crown, making the game easier for newer players.

worldSummary: Mario, Luigi and friends cross the Mushroom Kingdom to reclaim Peach's Castle from Bowser and the Koopalings. The package also includes New Super Luigi U, which remixes the adventure into shorter, more time-pressured courses.

storyChapters.title: Bowser attacks
storyChapters.body: Bowser's forces seize Peach's Castle and launch Mario and friends far across the Mushroom Kingdom.

storyChapters.title: The road back
storyChapters.body: The heroes travel through themed worlds, fortresses and airships to reach the castle.

storyChapters.title: New Super Luigi U
storyChapters.body: A faster remix gives Luigi and friends shorter timers and altered courses.

faq.q: Does it include New Super Luigi U?
faq.a: Yes. Both New Super Mario Bros. U and New Super Luigi U are included.
No. The core multiplayer is local on one system.

verdictSummary: A generous and technically polished package of traditional 2D Mario, especially valuable for players who missed the Wii U originals.
verdictCons: Conservative compared with newer Mario designs
Returning Wii U players may find limited novelty
